name: Frontend Design
description: Improve a screen inside the product's existing design language, and capture a screenshot when the browser is available.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read the current layout, components, and styles.
Find the shared components and tokens the screen already uses.
Apply a visual change that stays in the existing design language.
Open the screen when a browser session is available.
Capture the screen after the change.
Read console errors on the page that was opened.
Typecheck when the visual change touches TypeScript.

validation.rule: The UI change uses the existing design language, and browser_screenshot was captured or visual verification was reported as unavailable.
